contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence on reliability. I am responding directly to ops, who claims the rollback path is proven 'per artifact:chaos-fanout-run-7' with zero data loss: that artifact id does not appear in the available artifact list, so it cannot be accepted as evidence, and it must not be treated as filling the gap I raised. The only runbook artifact that actually exists, artifact:ops-runbook, states plainly that no chaos experiment has ever been performed against the fan-out worker — which contradicts the ops claim rather than supporting it. Nothing new has appeared since my last position: artifact:incident-log still records two sev2 retry-storm incidents last quarter in exactly the component this change touches, and artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) plus artifact:perf-report (p99 in budget) still do not exercise retry behavior under downstream degradation. The reliability bar remains unmet pending a chaos/fault-injection run targeting retry-storm behavior and evidence the change does not amplify retry fan-out.
